task:
Inspect up to the 10 most recent substantive proposals in #feedback-and-ideas. For each, report the author, timestamp, concise proposal, visible reaction count, visible
    reply count, and any explicitly stated benefit or concern from its thread. Rank the 3 proposals with the highest combined visible reactions and replies, preserving chronological
    order for ties. If fewer proposals exist, analyze all available. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any Slack content.

target.name: Daytona: Spot GPU sandboxes are now live for everyone! Run GPU workloads on preemptible capacity at a fraction of on-demand pricing: • No quotas: spot GPUs don't count against your GPU quota. Available capacity is the only limit. . • Deeply discounted: significantly cheaper than on-demand GPUs, see the pricing page: [ https://www.daytona.io/pricing (link)] . • All GPU types: H100, H200, RTX Pro 6000, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, with ordered fallback between types. . Getting started: choose a GPU, set resources, and use any Docker image: sandbox = daytona.create( CreateSandboxFromImageParams( image="nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-base-ubuntu22.04", auto_delete_interval=0, spot=True, resources=Resources(gpu=1, gpu_type=GpuType.H100), ) ) Heads up: spot sandboxes are preemptible. They can be reclaimed at any time when on-demand capacity is needed, so design workloads to tolerate interruption. Preempted sandboxes get a spotEvictedAt timestamp and stay retrievable for 24 hours. Try it: [ https://app.daytona.io/ (link)] Docs: [ https://www.daytona.io/docs/sandboxes#spot-gpu-sandboxes (link)] Questions?
